Element X refreshes its sign-in on its own again after the move to Synapse 1.164.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Synapse [v1.164.2](https://github.com/element-hq/synapse/releases/tag/v1.164.2).** It answers the old address Element X asks when it refreshes its token. Since Synapse 1.164, Element X could end up saying it can't reach the homeserver, and only a new sign-in or a proxy rule got it syncing again. With 1.164.2 it refreshes by itself, and the proxy rule is no longer needed.
- **authlib 1.9.2.**

## 📋 Notes

- **The [setup guide](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/matrix/blob/main/docs/setup.md#element-x-says-it-cant-reach-the-homeserver) explains the Element X sign-in loop** and the proxy rule for anyone still on 3.5.1.
